title: Research theorem: nine-call bound for arbitrary invertible three-register targets
head: a942c0ae1b463710ca535c1fba1b07b6431b5a86
body:
PR468 proves that three invertible lower-triangular rational 3×3 targets need nine rank-one calls in the abelian three-register bit model. This research theorem removes the target-triangularity assumption: the minimum remains nine for **arbitrary invertible rational targets**.

The new connection is to extract a dimension-independent disjoint-subset lemma from PR468's low-corank argument. With at most two frame relations, every target is a sum of a disjoint subset of paid frames. This gives a six-call bound for arbitrary invertible 2×2 target triples and closes the formerly flagged block case in address span four. The other reductions and the complete span-five search remain unchanged. The note expands the proof, including the associated-graded common-J argument, rather than extrapolating from a bounded word test.

The extension covers strictly more targets: the package exhibits I, C, C² with characteristic polynomial of C equal to x³−2. These cannot be made jointly lower triangular by any common rational left/right coordinate changes. Their nine-call construction is checked as an exact formal group-algebra identity.

Validation:

- Both unchanged exact engines completed 2,276 families and 21,317,520 orders, with agreement on all per-family counts, 415,398 diagonal terminals, and zero survivors. The cold replay took about 249 seconds; `REPLAY.json` records its source hashes and canonical per-family digest.
- A separate outer-product/basis implementation checks all 129 scalar pattern planes, with explicit witnesses for 123 common flags and all six exceptions. Exact polynomial identities, a bounded 77,540-word consistency census, and meaningful negative controls accompany the written universal proof.
- Normal, optimized and relocated quick runs pass. Corrupt source pins, finite certificates, formal replay controls, source inventories, coverage counts and survivor results are rejected. `make selected-record-check` passes.

Quick reproduction:

```sh
python3 -B -S research/three-register-no-target-flag/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_NINE_CALLS_WITHOUT_TARGET_FLAG`. Add `--full --work-dir /tmp/three-register-no-flag` for both complete inherited engines. The recorded full run used the predecessor driver directly; the new wrapper validator was checked against its output without repeating the expensive run.

Base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60`. Predecessor: Ali Romman's PR468 at `07a78bf335b0b5039a1fecd7cd74a0fe1d1605ea`; all seven preserved files are pinned in `SOURCES.json`. Credits also include eumemic's PR288 and huxint's PR203 for the inherited model and flag/projection methods. PR700 is not a dependency. Prepared by David Govea with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and parallel AI proof audits; no independent human peer review or proof-assistant formalization is claimed.

All additions are confined to `research/three-register-no-target-flag/`. This is a scoped lower-bound theorem for the stated formal three-register model, not a new κ, an extra-register result, or a full multiplication theorem. The selected frontier and `upstream/` are untouched. Assignment seed 66; no pinned coordination issue was available, so the sprint claim is local. Open PRs were refreshed before submission; PR705's complex path-homogeneity result has a distinct model and hypothesis.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
